rdfs:label: hasRelated
rdfs:comment: A related contact for the vCard — typically another person (spouse, child, colleague) connected to the subject.
notes: vCard's general inter-contact relation. For typed relations, make the value a node typed with a vcard:RelatedType subclass (`vcard:Spouse`, `vcard:Colleague`, `vcard:Friend`, ...) carrying `vcard:hasValue` to the related card/WebID. Distinct from SKOS `urn:solid:related` (between Concepts) and from FOAF `urn:solid:knows` (between Persons in a social-graph sense).

examples.title: vCard pointing at a related contact

history.note: Replaced non-existent vcard:hasRelatedType with RelatedType-typed node guidance; added knows to notToBeConfusedWith.
